content_sections.heading: BRIC THSTI Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the BRIC THSTI Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. Reading the official document is important to ensure that you meet all requirements before submitting the application form. Download BRIC THSTI Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: BRIC THSTI Vacancy Details 2026
content_sections.text: A total of 6 vacancies are available - 2 for Assistant Data Manager, 1 for Project Technical Support-II, 1 for Project Technical Support-III, 1 for Statistical Programmer, and 1 for Project Research Scientist-II.

content_sections.heading: BRIC THSTI Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Assistant Data Manager: Post Graduate degree in Computer Application/Computer Science/Data Science OR Graduate degree in Computer Science/Computer Application with 2 years experience in clinical data management. Project Technical Support-II: Standard 12th in Science plus DMLT/Diploma in Engineering or equivalent with 5 years experience OR Graduation with 2 years experience in research lab. Project Technical Support-III: Three-year graduate degree in Life Sciences with 3 years experience OR Post-Graduation in Life Sciences. Statistical Programmer: Post-Graduation in Statistics/Mathematics & Computing/Information Technology/Bioinformatics/Biostatistics with 2 years experience. Project Research Scientist-II: Ph.D. in Life Sciences in tuberculosis area with 1 research article in PubMed-indexed journal and BSL-3 experience.

content_sections.heading: BRIC THSTI Recruitment 2026 - Age Limit
content_sections.text: Age relaxation is applicable as per government rules: SC/ST: 5 years, OBC: 3 years, PwBD: 10-15 years, Ex-servicemen: as per rules.

content_sections.heading: BRIC THSTI Recruitment 2026 - Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the total number of vacancies announced by BRIC THSTI?
faq.answer: BRIC THSTI has announced a total of 6 vacancies for various project positions through a walk-in interview process.

faq.question: Q2. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is Walk-in. Candidates need to attend the interview directly at the specified venue and time.

faq.question: Q3. What are the educational qualifications required for the posts?
faq.answer: Educational qualifications vary by post, ranging from 12th Science with DMLT/Diploma to Ph.D. in Life Sciences, with specific experience requirements for some roles.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for the BRIC THSTI recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Project Research Scientist-II position?
faq.answer: The salary offered for the Project Research Scientist-II position is Rs. 67,000/- plus HRA.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for these positions?
faq.answer: The selection process typically includes a Written Test, Skill Test, Interview, and Document Verification.

faq.question: Q7. Where is the walk-in interview scheduled to be held?
faq.answer: The walk-in interviews are scheduled to be held at BRIC THSTI, Faridabad, Haryana, 121001.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should candidates carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates should carry all original documents, self-attested photocopies, ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates, and passport-size photographs.

faq.question: Q9. Are there any age relaxations provided?
faq.answer: Yes, age relaxation is provided for SC/ST (5 years), OBC (3 years), PwBD (10-15 years), and Ex-servicemen as per rules.

faq.question: Q10. When is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for any post?
faq.answer: The walk-in interviews are scheduled from 10 August 2026 to 17 August 2026, depending on the specific post.
